ner_meta.what_the_seconds_are: wall seconds of one host job (the job's end minus its start, as the host queue recorded it), one CPU reserved per job; summed over parts they are reserved CPU-seconds (one CPU times wall seconds), not a CPU-time reading. The job runs under a retry wrapper that reruns only after a Windows file-lock error (up to 3 runs, 60 s apart), so a rerun, if one happened, is inside the job's seconds; the queue state does not say whether any did. The job also includes its own start-up (unpacking, imports, model load)
ner_meta.peak_is: the host job record's peak memory (the larger of its peak and live readings)

pools_note.text: Why this spaCy row is in the final system. The pools keep the package's spaCy-built ner family. U2l graded a spaCy-free entity family, E1 (IS alone; on a passage graph E1 together with R, the sibling links (`docs/U2L_ENTITY_MATCH.md` line 85), is W2_S array for array, line 192), and filed CHOSEN E1 (line 178); U2r graded name rules beside it and kept E1 (`docs/U2R_NAME_RULE.md` line 134, filed in 14a48ee). The pool test with E1 in the ner slot was NO_GAIN (`docs/U2M_POOLS_THREE_FAMILIES.md` section 20, line 804, filed in a2a2627 on 2026-10-27, code at fcd0f08; record `outputs/u2m/e1/verdict_e1.json`, `verdict`): on musique the I (the base and seeds plus the expansion over the three families, line 63) holds every gold (ALL, the share of questions with every gold in the pool, `docs/P1E_ANCHOR_KIND.md` line 135) for 0.7751 of the questions with the filed families (2,067.2 rows) and for 0.6838 with E1's (1,199.7 rows) (doc line 821; record `the_I.musique`). The doc reads this as musique's I reading the ner family, whose links carry bridge entities that W2_S does not reach (lines 836 to 837), and it states that the pools keep the package's NER (lines 806 to 807). U2r's model-free name rule (N1) was not adopted either: it lost 2wiki's pools by 0.0226 (`docs/NMD_NAME_LINK_DIAG.md` line 43). So the models of record read the package's spaCy-built ner family: in their pools (the models' compiled edges read all three families on every dataset, `docs/U2M_POOLS_THREE_FAMILIES.md` line 22) and in the B1 carves (carve b1 holds the NER and KNN graphs, `docs/B1H_MODELS_OF_RECORD_ON_HYPERLINKS.md` line 29; carve b1t is the NER and KNN families alone, `docs/B1L_MODELS_OF_RECORD_ON_THE_LLM_GRAPH.md` line 19; the carve's ner graph is rebuilt with spaCy, `docs/B1_HIPPORAG2_ALIGNMENT.md` lines 68 to 69). W2_S rule links (no spaCy), section 2, uses no spaCy. Superseded for the pools: `docs/U2R_NAME_RULE.md` lines 17 and 135 describe the pools' entity family as the title links alone; they date from 2026-10-26, and section 20 of the pool doc (2026-10-27) is the later record.
